title: Service Guarantee Schedule: Discount Rate for Customer-Pay Repair Overruns (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Schedule.** The discount rate, in percent, of the repair-customer discount credit on a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network customer-pay repair depends on how far the repair ran past its target ready date, counted in business days (Monday to Friday) from the repair start date to the ready date less the repair tier's target turnaround in business days: an overrun of more than 3 business days doubles the class customer-pay discount percent; an overrun of one business day up to 3 business days takes the class customer-pay discount percent plus 5; no overrun takes the class customer-pay discount percent.

## Records read

The repair start date, the ready date and the target turnaround in business days of the repair's service tier, all from the repair order under Customer-Pay Repairs the rental is tied to.

## Counting the business days

The business days are each Monday-to-Friday day after the repair start date, up to and including the ready date. The overrun is that count less the target turnaround; a count at or below the target is no overrun.

## Rates (class customer-pay discount of 10 percent in every class)

| Overrun in business days | Discount rate |
|---|---|
| None (0 or less) | 10 percent, the class customer-pay discount percent |
| 1 to 3 | 15 percent, the class percent plus 5 |
| More than 3 | 20 percent, twice the class percent |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Repair started on a Monday and ready on the Friday of the following week: 9 business days. Against a target of 6 the overrun is 3, at the top of the 1-to-3 band, so 15 percent; against a target of 5 the overrun is 4, above 3, so 20 percent.
- Against a target of 9 the same repair has no overrun, so 10 percent; against a target of 8 the overrun is 1, so 15 percent.
